senses.gloss: m. (μονοπώλιον) a trading mart enjoying a monopoly.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Demai 5:4">Dem. V, 4</cite> <he>בלוקח מן המ׳</he> when he buys (loaves of bread) in a monopolized market (where the numbers of bakers and of retailers are limited). Y. ib. 24ᵈ top <he>איזהו מ׳ וכ׳</he> what sort of a mart? Where there are nine sellers supplied by eight bakers, so that eight may have bought from one baker severally, but one baker must necessarily have supplied at least two sellers.
